scope: Section21.4 bounded targeted 2024-2026 NIDS literature check; not an exhaustive systematic review, not new baseline execution, no mechanism proposal.

provenance.curation: Integrated primary-source notes with quantitative evidence binding; removed operational collaboration phrasing and corrected a misleading global-deduplication descriptor. Scientific results and cited-paper numbers unchanged.

issue_gate.literature_basis: At least three distinct direct recent works (Two-Stage, AdvAs-IIDS, ExBCIL) already target broad incremental performance/retention; attack-adaptive IoT is another direct work. ACIL is a framework, not a new verified runnable method.

issue_gate.observed: UNSW Backdoor/Fuzzers and CIC17 Botnet/Normal satisfy per-class magnitude/direction gates, but these heterogeneous classes do not establish the same problem across two datasets.

current_decision.ranking_status: No final candidate ranking while Section21.4 quantitative literature coverage is incomplete; do not force three candidates.
current_decision.unfinished: Paired improvement magnitudes and detailed stream/memory protocols for several publisher-preview-only papers remain unverified. Unknown is not zero, no-code, irrelevant, or ineffective.

class_incremental_and_class_imbalance.scope: Section21 G1/G2 primary-source literature evidence only; no mechanism proposal or baseline efficacy claim under our protocol.
class_incremental_and_class_imbalance.counting_rule: Count each DOI once; author manuscript and journal version are the same work. Publication-online and issue years do not create additional works.

interpretation.G1_broad_retention_and_multiclass_adapta: At least four independent direct-method/evaluation works below address this broad objective, plus the ACIL framework; broad-topic sparsity is not established.
interpretation.G2_local_class_recall: Two-Stage and ACIL directly address class imbalance or minority/new-class bias. The other works are adjacent through memory representation, new/old sample imbalance or scarce new attacks. This does not establish a literature count for every particular class-level failure.
interpretation.quantitative_limits: Missing improvement values are unknown, not zero or ineffective. Published improvements use their own protocols and cannot be pooled with our Joint-minus-fixed-best gaps. None of these works was established ineffective by this literature search.
interpretation.candidate_limits: Do not merge different dataset-specific classes post hoc to meet the two-dataset quantitative gate; do not count G2 classwise envelopes as one realizable classifier or duplicate G1 into a second candidate. Final literature-gap/candidate decisions remain with the combined report.

works.title: Attack-adaptive network intrusion detection systems for IoT networks through class incremental learning

primary_sources.access: Full text labeled author content uploaded by Domenico Ciuonzo on 2025-03-17; same DOI/work, not a second publication.

works.protocol: 2D-CNN packet/biflow input; multiclass attack classification and separate binary misuse detection. 70/30 holdout; N runs each with one withheld attack added once. Table means average attack-held-out runs, not five fixed seeds. Base: 25 exemplars/class, 10 packets, base fields.
works.quantitative_limits: BiC sensitivity-selected configurations change memory, packets and/or fields together; gains are not matched-budget causal effects or our Joint gaps. Standard deviations are not reproduced here.

scope.matching_rule: Exact targeting requires evaluated cross-environment benign/Normal drift and a Normal false-positive or Normal-recall endpoint. Generic concept drift, emerging attacks, overall accuracy, or separate within-dataset evaluations do not establish that match.
